context.transcript:
Thanks everyone for attending this meeting.
The factory received a rush order for 75 additional Kinsley desk chairs from an important retail client.
They want these chairs in two weeks.
Shift managers tell me that we may not have enough staff available to meet this deadline.
Plus, I've learned that an automated fabric cutting machine hasn't been working properly.
Some of that work must be done by hand, so I need volunteers for fabric cutting.
There is a sign-up sheet to my left.
I have also reached out to Human Resources about hiring temporary staff.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢各位参加本次会议。
工厂收到了一笔来自重要零售客户的75张额外的Kinsley办公椅的紧急订单。
他们要求这两周内交货。
班组经理告诉我，我们可能没有足够的员工来满足这个期限。
此外，我了解到一台自动织物切割机运行不正常。
其中一些工作必须手工完成，所以我需要志愿者进行织物切割。
我的左边有一个签到表。
我还联系了人力资源部门，询问招聘临时员工的事宜。
